page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a bare-metal server instance featuring 128 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 768 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of memory per core. The host includes four NVIDIA A10 GPUs offering a total of 96 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities are anchored by a 64 Gbps baseline bandwidth connection. The instance does not feature local NVMe storage, relying on attached cloud storage volumes for all disk persistent requirements.

The hardware configuration provides high compute and memory density coupled with quad-GPU acceleration. With 96 GB of total VRAM across four accelerators, the instance balances core count against parallel floating-point processing capabilities. The absence of integrated local storage creates a dependency on remote block storage performance, making network bandwidth utilization important for data-intensive I/O pipelines.

This server is designed for graphics processing, artificial intelligence inference, real-time video transcoding, cloud rendering, and data science workloads that benefit from multi-GPU execution alongside high vCPU core counts.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a bare-metal GPU instance engineered for graphics and machine learning workloads. Powered by 128 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 768 GB of RAM, it delivers 6.0 GB of memory per core alongside four NVIDIA A10 GPUs totaling 96 GB of VRAM. Networking features a 64 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The server contains no local storage, requiring network-attached cloud storage for persistent disk operations. The combination of dense vCPU resource allocation, multi-GPU acceleration, and high baseline throughput positions the server effectively for multi-channel video encoding, AI inference, cloud rendering, and parallelized data science tasks without hypervisor resource overhead.
